title.original: AgentDoG: A Diagnostic Guardrail Framework for AI Agent Safety and Security
title.zh: AgentDoG：AI 智能体安全保障的诊断护栏框架
title.en: AgentDoG: A Diagnostic Guardrail Framework for AI Agent Safety and Security

inclusion_reason.zh: AgentDoG 统一风险分类、轨迹监控和根因诊断输出，可作为不同 Agent 执行循环中的细粒度 Guardrail 服务。
inclusion_reason.en: AgentDoG unifies risk taxonomy, trajectory monitoring, and causal diagnosis as a fine-grained guardrail service for different agent loops.

abstract.zh: AgentDoG 以“风险来源—失效方式—后果”三维分类指导轨迹级 Guardrail，不仅拦截风险，还诊断不安全或不合理动作的根因。
abstract.en: AgentDoG uses a source-mode-consequence risk taxonomy to guide trajectory-level guardrails that both moderate behavior and diagnose causes of unsafe or unreasonable actions.

problem.zh: 通用 Guardrail 缺少 Agent 工具与环境风险意识，二元安全标签也无法解释错误来自何处、如何发生及会造成什么后果。
problem.en: General guardrails lack awareness of tool and environment risks, and binary labels do not explain where a failure originated, how it occurred, or what it caused.

approach.zh: 作者构建正交层次风险分类与 ATBench，并训练多尺寸 AgentDoG 模型对完整交互轨迹做细粒度上下文监控和根因诊断。
approach.en: The work builds an orthogonal hierarchical taxonomy and ATBench, then trains several AgentDoG models for fine-grained contextual monitoring and root-cause diagnosis over trajectories.

system_design.zh: Guardrail 接收动作、工具反馈和历史上下文，输出三维风险标签、根因解释与处置判断；模型和基准共享同一分类契约。
system_design.en: The guardrail consumes actions, tool feedback, and history and emits three-dimensional risk labels, causal diagnosis, and moderation decisions under a shared taxonomy.

key_results.zh: 不同尺寸的 AgentDoG 在复杂交互安全审核中优于既有方法，并提供普通安全分类器缺少的来源与失效透明度。
key_results.en: AgentDoG variants outperform prior moderation methods in complex interactive scenarios while adding source and failure transparency absent from ordinary safety classifiers.

limitations.zh: 诊断仍由学习模型生成，可能被分布外轨迹或对抗表述规避；ATBench 的分类边界也会限制未见风险的识别。
limitations.en: Diagnosis is still model-generated and may fail on out-of-distribution or adversarial traces, while ATBench's taxonomy bounds recognition of unseen risks.

notes.zh: 上述非空 evaluation 标签仅来自官方 arXiv 摘要；摘要未给出可安全转录的表格级数值、硬件与集群配置，相关细节仍待全文审计。
notes.en: The non-empty evaluation labels above come only from the official arXiv abstract; it provides no table-level numbers, hardware, or cluster configuration safe to transcribe, so those details await full-text audit.
